request.spec:
The sheet has a policy date (settings, SETTING_CHANGED key=policy-date value=<date>); when it is
blank the policy date is the sheet's today. A claim dated before the policy date rounds half up;
a claim dated on or after it rounds half to even. This decides every rounding of that claim's live
figures (the rate step and the late charge). A correction rounds by the date of the claim it
corrects, not its own. Settled figures stay frozen and figures bound by a statement stay bound.

agent.result_text:
The rounding policy date is in: `bin/e2e` builds the app and all 4 tests in the spec pass.

**How it works now**
- **Setting:** the settings form has a new policy-date field (`setting-policy-date`, with the saved value shown in `setting-policy-date-current`). It accepts a `yyyy-mm-dd` date or blank, and anything else shows `settings-error`. Saving writes `SETTING_CHANGED ... key=policy-date value=<date>`, with nothing after `value=` when it's blank.
- **The rule:** a claim dated before the policy date rounds half up; one dated on or after it rounds half to even. Blank means the sheet's today. A correction uses the date of the claim it corrects (the same person's claim with that number), not its own date.
- **What it applies to:** the rule covers both live roundings, the rate step and the late charge. Settled amounts and amounts fixed by a statement are stored values, so they don't change.

**Changes**
- **Database:** new migration `V25__policy_date.sql` adds a nullable `policy_date` column to the sheet.
- **Server:** the settings classes now read, check and save the policy date and write its audit line. `ClaimRepository` has a new `rounding(sheetId, claim)` that picks the rounding mode; the due and late-charge calculations use it instead of always rounding half to even.
- **Front end:** the screen works out dues itself, so the same rule had to go there too.
  - In `useRates.ts`, the rounding functions take a half-up flag.
  - `useOverdue.ts` has `roundsHalfUp`, plus a helper `claimDueNow` that the four places showing dues now all call (claim rows, person totals, overdue totals and period totals). Those four had the same expression copied into each.
  - I also removed two imports that were no longer used.

Changing the policy date can change live totals. Saving settings already records a rollup line in the audit file when totals change, so that now also happens after a policy-date change.
